name: Who Did I Sleep with Last Night?!
source:
Fueled by an incident at the house where 5 other male students are living, One groggy morning our main character surprisingly woke up naked in his room unable to remember anything from last night, He is determined to find out what happened and to know who he had sleep with that night.

You’ll help our main character explore his sexuality while finding out who he had sleep with last night.
translation:
在一栋合住着另外5名男学生的屋子里发生了一场意外风波后，某个头昏脑涨的清晨，我们的男主角惊讶地发现自己一丝不挂地躺在房间里，对昨晚发生的事毫无印象。他下定决心要查清昨晚的来龙去脉，揪出那晚究竟是谁和自己同床共枕。

你将协助男主角探索自身的性取向，同时查明昨晚与他共度春宵的神秘对象。
